title: FIPS mesh dashboard tab in DNS/operator UI
observed_behavior: The DNS dashboard exposed zones, endpoints, drift, and policies from Nostr read models, while FIPS mesh worker and endpoint read-model data was available only in web/src/lib/stores/fips-mesh.svelte.js without a human operator surface.
intended_behavior: The DNS/operator dashboard exposes a FIPS/Mesh tab backed by the existing FIPS mesh Nostr read-model store. The tab displays mesh-connected workers/endpoints, overlay addresses, Nostr identifiers, transport endpoints, DNS/FIPS hostnames, mesh health metrics, projection status, and gating reasons. Operators can filter by health, worker, capability, and projection state. Empty/error states distinguish relay/FIPS unavailability from no projected mesh nodes. Lifecycle remains event-driven through the EOSE-aware FIPS mesh store with no new REST endpoints or polling.
out_of_scope: DNS command-control changes coordinated under bahia-mou1
New backend FIPS mesh projection semantics
